pr_body: When zoomed in, the right and bottom edges of the resource image will be outside the viewing area. This is the original look, but the scrollbar has reached the end. When I zoomed in, the lower edge of the picture was out of view. After fixing the problem. Fixes #44592

issue_context.title: Polygon 2D UV Editor picture size not match to scrollbar
issue_context.body:

**Godot version:**
<!-- Specify commit hash if using non-official build. -->
3.2.*

**OS/device including version:**
<!-- Specify GPU model, drivers, and the backend (GLES2, GLES3, Vulkan) if graphics-related. -->
GLES3 and GLES2 both.

**Issue description:**
<!-- What happened, and what was expected. -->
当放大图片后，水平滚动条不能移动到图片的最右方。
translate by deepl: The horizontal scrollbar does not move to the far right of the image when the image is zoomed in.

**Steps to reproduce:**
1. Create a Polygon 2D node.
2. Set texture (in my case 512x512 pix).
3. Open Polygon 2D Editor.
4. use mouse middle Scroll up enlarge the picture.
5. move the horizontal scrollbar to most right
6. then cant arrive the picture right side

**Minimal reproduction project:**
<!-- A small Godot project which reproduces the issue. Drag and drop a zip archive to upload it. -->

review_comments: `Size2` supports unary `-` so it should just be `rect.position = -uv_edit_draw->get_size();` no?

OK. I wrote this so that I could, at first glance, associate the offset with the location. I will delete Size() and try again.
Thank you for your advice and response.
